title: 与謝蕪村の俳句 (Haiku by Yosa Buson)
description: Four famous haiku by Yosa Buson (1716–1784), painter and poet. Where Bashō sought spiritual depth and Issa sought emotional warmth, Buson brought a painter's eye for vivid, sensory images: rapeseed flowers with the moon and sun at opposite ends of the sky; lazy spring waves; the joy of wading a summer river barefoot.
author: 与謝蕪村 (Yosa Buson, 1716–1784)
